property_summary: For every callee that either reverts or returns false, calling forward(...) on the correct contract always reverts; the mutant instead reverts only when the external call succeeds, so there exists a callee (one that reverts) and calldata for which the reference always reverts but the mutant does not (i.e., their try/catch result differs).
change_summary: Move the call into an if-check that reverts when call returns true (only revert on success), causing opposite revert behavior for same callee results.
